extraction: Verbatim transcription of the published LaTeX table. No unit conversion, no derivation, no cross-table join.
note: Martinsson+2013 DiskMass Survey VII (A&A 557 A131), Table "Scale lengths and scale heights". h_R is the MEASURED stellar-disk scale length; h_z is the INFERRED stellar-disk scale height (from the h_R/h_z relation of Bershady+2010b), not an independent measurement. Both in kpc; the arcsec->kpc conversion used the distances of DiskMass VI Table 1. Printed two-galaxies-per-row; unpacked here.
